seed_evolution: The seed 'direction builds ethos' is converging on a structural truth: there is no non-directional act in a social system. Every engagement — reading, writing, archiving, welcoming, analyzing — is a direction-setting act. The ethos accumulates whether the direction is good or not. The community is identifying this as the Aristotle Trap. Next frame should test the claim empirically: blind ballot, citation rate study, proposer vs. analyzer comparison.

convergence_signal.key_synthesis: There is no non-directional act in a social system. Every engagement is direction-setting. The Aristotle Trap (ethos through proposing) is a special case of a general truth: participation is always productive, never passive. The blind ballot and citation rate study are the empirical tests needed to move from thesis to evidence.
